text.p: Swiss shares dropped in the second half of the session to close near intraday's lows when investors turned cautious after after watching the market spend most of the day in positive terrain.

"Today was disappointing for bulls and bears alike", a trader said, adding the bourse showed little reaction to U.S. economic data. An easier Wall Street put some pressure on the stocks in late trade. But one trader said investors may find the current levels attractive.

The blue-chip Swiss Market Index ended down 8.9 points, or 0.24 percent, at 3,723.1 and the the all-share Swiss Performance Index fell 4.49 points, or 0.19 percent, to 2,391.32 points. Volumes were described as light.
Actively-traded Nestle gave up 10 francs to 1,365.

Banks and insurers were mostly lower. Swiss Re, which had shown solid advances in the past few days, ended one franc lower at 1,352. The company said it would release definitive figures for 1995 on Friday at around 0800 GMT.
Roche certificates stood out among pharmceuticals, advancing five francs to 9,525.
Industrials were mostly mixed. ABB and Electrowatt ended slightly higher.
Adia was up one franc to 366.

Swissair also added one franc to 987. Traders said the stock may be in the limelight on Thursday if Belgian carrier Sabena, in which Swissair has a 49.5 percent stake, reaches an accord with its union.
